name: MedPal AI Plc
summary: MedPal AI PLC operates as a digital health and artificial intelligence company focused on wellness management in United Kingdom. The company's application aggregates data from wearable fitness trackers or health apps, such as Apple Health, Google Fit, Whoop, Fitbit, and Garmin into a unified health profile, enabling personalized lifestyle recommendations through its AI wellness coach, as well as operates as a non-clinical wellness facilitator. MedPal AI PLC was incorporated in 2021 and is based in London, United Kingdom.
